title: fix(storage): S3 chunked upload fails with 'key not found for uploadId' behind the swappable storage proxy
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Single-node defect S2, found by card 0 of #3814 (cloud#3868 comment 6723322368, smoke). Maintainer ruling D2 (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「现在修，按普通 bug 卡」. This is a single-node bug fix, so it is NOT bound by #3814's R3.

## Problem
Chunk 0 of an S3 chunked upload returns 500 with "S3StorageAdapter: key not found for uploadId" on a single replica. The swappable storage proxy hides `setUploadKey` (`storage-routes.ts:1278`, `attachment-lifecycle.ts:764-770`), so the adapter's per-process uploadId-to-key map is never filled. The map is also per process, so it cannot work across replicas either.

## Do
1. Resolve the object key from the `sys_upload_session` row (the durable record) instead of the adapter's in-process map, or pass the key through the proxy. Prefer the row: it fixes single node and round-robin together.
2. Tests: a chunked upload through the swappable proxy against an S3-compatible stand-in completes; a resumed chunk on a fresh adapter instance (a second process) finds the key.

## Done when
PR merged; chunked uploads to S3 succeed on a single node and on any replica.

Dedup: card 0 found no existing issue.
